events.title: Kendall Farrell – Live Comedy Special Taping
events.description: nyc comedian kendall farrell tapes his first stand up special at littlefield (gowanus)! named a 'comic to watch' at the new york comedy festival and a 'breakout artist' by carolines on broadway, kendall has opened for na...
events.details: sun 7pm + 9:30pm:: nyc comedian kendall farrell tapes his first stand up special at littlefield (gowanus)! named a 'comic to watch' at the new york comedy festival and a 'breakout artist' by carolines on broadway, kendall has opened for national headliners like michelle wolf, beth stelling, drew lynch and matteo lane, and his work has been seen/heard on siriusxm, cracked and adult swim. in this hour, farrell discusses using manosphere logic to explain that gender is a spectrum, the difference between gay and straight men's nudes, and being a liberal black sheep in a conservative family — with some thoughts on whether you can actually bl*w your way to the top. if you have never been to a comedy special taping before, this is your chance to be a part of a uniquely cool, fun and rare nyc experience! special offer: just $5 with promo code 'five'
